# Sandysup

> Sleep and relaxation videos: real kinetic sand ASMR with no talking, and 1-hour rain sounds with no music.

This site indexes the YouTube channels below so people and AI assistants can find the right video by length, sound and mood. All videos play on YouTube.

- Full catalog (JSON, every public video with length and attributes): https://nbraga8604.github.io/videos.json
- Sitemap: https://nbraga8604.github.io/sitemap.xml

## AsmrSandysup

AsmrSandysup films real kinetic sand being cut, sliced and crushed by hand, recorded close up so you hear the natural crunch. There is no talking and no background music. Videos range from short clips to longer sessions, for winding down, falling asleep or background focus.

- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@AsmrSandysup
- Channel page: https://nbraga8604.github.io/sand/
- Public videos: 5

### Videos (longest first)

- [ASMR Kinetic Sand Cutting 🌈 Satisfying Rainbow Cube Slicing | New Channel!](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9QjE-I6gvJI) — 10:21 — sleep, kinetic sand, cutting, crunchy, rainbow, no talking
- [ASMR Kinetic Sand – Crunchy Rainbow Block Cutting, Oddly Satisfying Sand Sounds (4K)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=t8Rbxz9QccE) — 6:41 — kinetic sand, cutting, crunchy, rainbow, no talking
- [ASMR Kinetic Sand Cutting 🌈 Satisfying RAINBOW CUBE SLICING 🌈  (No Talking) New Channel!](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CI6P1HzEfMc) — 2:05 — sleep, kinetic sand, cutting, crunchy, rainbow, no talking
- [Purple Glitter Rainbow Kinetic Sand 🌈 AMSR Cube cutting  New Channel (No Talking )](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YQBaDPcAOVo) — 0:24 — kinetic sand, cutting, glitter, rainbow, no talking
- [ASMR Kinetic Sand Cutting 🌈 Satisfying Rainbow Cube Slicing | New Channel!](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gF7c8Qp9SSg) — 0:24 — sleep, kinetic sand, cutting, crunchy, rainbow, no talking

## Relaxtion Express Network

Relaxtion Express Network posts one-hour rain soundscapes for sleeping, studying and relaxing: rain on a window, a glass roof, a covered porch, a lakeside boathouse and a jungle treehouse at night. The long videos are rain only, with no music and no talking, so they can play in the background all night.

- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@Relaxtion_Express_Network
- Channel page: https://nbraga8604.github.io/rain/
- Public videos: 11
